first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The foreground person on the image-right in the first frame, wearing a tilted gray wide-brimmed steel helmet and a tan-brown outer layer; in the last frame, a light-colored backpack is visible from behind on the image-right.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person on the image-left in the first frame, wearing a gray steel helmet, a stand-collar uniform, and a tan-brown sleeveless outer layer, with light-colored straps; later, a backpack, a long gun, and a dark red upper-arm cloth patch are visible from behind on the image-left.

entities.name: trench wall
entities.identification: Brown earthen walls and wooden reinforcement structures; later, a gray corrugated panel is partially visible at the base of the wall. Excludes the sandbags, the mound of earth atop the wall, and the ground.

entities.name: group of other soldiers in the trench
entities.identification: Retain the scope of the group in the source background; later in this clip, one person from the group is visible wearing a gray steel helmet and a yellowish-brown outer garment.

entities.name: muddy passageway ground
entities.identification: The narrow gray-brown ground between the walls on both sides, with a light, wet-looking appearance in places.

entities.name: brown sandbags atop the wall
entities.identification: Tan-brown elongated rounded bags stacked horizontally along the top of the wall.

entities.name: exposed mound of earth atop the wall
entities.identification: An uneven, irregular mound of exposed brown earth with a rough surface behind the sandbags.

entities.name: grayish-white sky
entities.identification: The low-saturation grayish-white sky with a slight gray-green cast above the terrain atop the wall.

entities.name: utility pole
entities.identification: Multiple slender vertical poles with crossarms above the top of the wall; their material cannot be determined from the current images.

entities.name: soldier's long gun
entities.identification: The collection of long guns protruding behind the persons' shoulders, with tan-brown wooden parts connected to dark metal parts.
